raw_text: BREAKING: Indian Navy has been tracking a Chinese nuclear-powered attack submarine (SSN) in the Bay of Bengal for 72 hours. P-8I Poseidon aircraft and INS Kadmatt (ASW corvette) deployed for sustained tracking east of Andaman & Nicobar. Submarine assessed as Type 093A Shang-class. Significant ASW operation underway.
